shared_elements: schematic carved band of repeated rectangular/grid units (teeth row in A, register of rectangles in B)
stone carving in relief/volume with simplified anatomical forms
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces use a horizontal strip of repeated rectangular units (the bared teeth in A, the banded register of rectangles in B) and both employ heavily simplified, blocky carved forms. Otherwise the content is entirely different — A is a single frontal anthropomorphic head with eyes, nose and a layered scalloped headdress, while B shows multiple animals in profile (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird, a scorpion-like creature) stacked in registers with no human face at all.
